steps.title: What is a fork?
steps.body: A fork is one piece attacking two targets at once. Knights are great at forks, because their jumps can land on squares that attack two pieces.

steps.title: The knight fork
steps.body: The knight jumps to c7. From there it attacks the rook on a8 and the king on e8 at the same time.

steps.title: Your fork
steps.body: Find the knight move that forks the king and the rook.
steps.hint: Look for a square that attacks both the king and the rook.
steps.success: Fork! The king must move, and then the knight takes the rook.

steps.question: Which piece made the fork?
steps.explanation: The knight's L-shaped jump let it attack two pieces at once.
